blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO, Zambales— The heat index in Olongapo City reached 40.8°C on Monday morning, increasing the risk of heat-related illnesses, according to real-time monitoring data. Data from the City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office showed a high heat index at the Barretto automatic weather station (AWS) as of 11 a.m., while the reading at the Old Cabalan AWS stood at 39.8 degrees Celsius. Both readings fell under the “extreme caution” category, where prolonged exposure to heat may cause heat cramps and heat exhaustion and, with continued activity in hot conditions, potentially lead to heat stroke.
